subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be resolved by accepting the linked 500-message fixed-window PR, or should closure require load-older pagination for Control UI history?
rationale: Source confirms the 100-message cap and the backend pagination contract, but choosing a larger fixed startup payload versus an on-demand older-history UX is a product/performance tradeoff that code inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand while preserving the bounded initial load.

options.title: Accept 500 after proof
options.body: Allow the linked PR to close the issue after real Control UI proof shows the larger fixed window is acceptable for long sessions.

options.title: Fold into canonical scrollback work
options.body: Close this only after the linked same-author PR is resolved or retargeted to the broader canonical pagination issue.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand while preserving the bounded initial load.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and prior chat-windowing history put the UI history limit and render-window behavior closest to this owner, while the remaining choice is UX/product shape.
